stem: A retained reference clone and a new accession share a name but differ at several validated molecular markers. What is the strongest next step?
choices: Treat the commercial name as proof they are identical
Investigate pedigree, chain-of-custody and broader identity evidence before merging the records
Ignore the molecular discrepancy if flower color is similar
rationale: Cultivar names alone are not reliable identity proof. Discordant molecular evidence should trigger traceability and identity review rather than automatic equivalence.
